text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho completed her Debut race, but 
she was so irritated and frustrated that 
she hadn't been able to concentrate on the 
race itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked by reporters about her next 
goal, she bluntly answered, "Hanshin JF." 
When scolded by a reporter for her 
attitude, she soured even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, she holed herself up in the 
waiting room and eventually fell asleep 
from exhaustion. For now, let's set our 
next goal on the Hanshin JF.
